CustomField.description: [8/22/2024] An integer field depicting how many FULL years it takes to get from the pledge's start date to the pledge's end date.
CustomField.formula: IF( /** If the YEARS are Equal, then the answer is always ZERO ** ELSE if the MONTHS AND DAYS are Equal....the answer is ENDYEAR - STARTYEAR ** ELSE DAYOFYEAR(EndDate) > DAYOFYEAR(StartDate)....the answer is ENDYEAR - STARTYEAR + 1 ** ELSE ... answer is ENDYEAR - STARTYEAR - 1 **/ OR( YEAR(ucinn_ascendv2__Start_Date__c) = YEAR(ucinn_ascendv2__End_Date__c ), AND( MONTH(ucinn_ascendv2__Start_Date__c) = MONTH(ucinn_ascendv2__End_Date__c ), DAY(ucinn_ascendv2__Start_Date__c) = DAY(ucinn_ascendv2__End_Date__c) ) ), YEAR(ucinn_ascendv2__End_Date__c) - YEAR(ucinn_ascendv2__Start_Date__c ), IF( DAYOFYEAR(ucinn_ascendv2__End_Date__c) > DAYOFYEAR(ucinn_ascendv2__Start_Date__c), YEAR(ucinn_ascendv2__End_Date__c) - YEAR(ucinn_ascendv2__Start_Date__c ) + 1, YEAR(ucinn_ascendv2__End_Date__c) - YEAR(ucinn_ascendv2__Start_Date__c ) -1 ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: How many years will it take to pay off the pledge?
CustomField.label: NU ADV Pledge Duration
